decisions.reason: Rejected for a clearly visible missing source feature: exact original and nearest8 face crop show two prominent dark arched eyebrows, while the unchanged full raw has smooth yellow skin above both green eyes and no separate eyebrows. This removes a definite source feature and its stern brow expression; visible-source-differences-v1 does not waive this clear difference. The close-cropped receding dark curly hair, smooth upper lip/chin, no hat/eyewear, neutral closed mouth, slightly screen-left head/shoulder orientation, ochre-olive military jacket, shoulder straps/buttons, pale pointed shirt collar, diagonally banded dark tie and crossed gold lapel emblems otherwise remain recognizable. Short broad yellow neck meets the fitted shirt with continuous contact shading, without a stalk, floating collar, clipping or cream bib. Pale gray-green complete painted rectangular backing, lighting and chest-up crop are retained with no invented card/note. Full white/cyan/alpha observations show no visible hole, transparency or lost backing. Actual original alpha255 throughout32760 pixels; raw alpha255 throughout1572855 pixels. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: fine internal insignia design, individual hair strands and minute tie pattern cannot be independently resolved in the156x210 source; no exact match is claimed for those details. The rejection is the clearly absent eyebrows, not these tiny-detail limits or alpha.
